name: NULL Pointer Dereference
title: CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in model serving and agent tooling, where a bad input reaches code that trusts a pointer to be valid. CVE-2026-70639 covers llama.cpp, a local inference engine, from build b1886 to b7445, where a corrupt model file fed through the Android JNI wrapper causes a crash. CVE-2026-47427 covers GitHub MCP Server before 1.1.0, where an unauthenticated request is enough to bring the server down. In both cases the attacker needs no special access, just a malformed file or a plain network request. The result is a denial of service, taking the model runner or the MCP server offline for everyone using it.
description: The product dereferences a pointer that it expects to be valid but is NULL.

mitigations.description: For any pointers that could have been modified or provided from a function that can return NULL, check the pointer for NULL before use. When working with a multithreaded or otherwise asynchronous environment, ensure that proper locking APIs are used to lock before the check, and unlock when it has finished [REF-1484].
Select a programming language that is not susceptible to these issues.
Check the results of all functions that return a value and verify that the value is non-null before acting upon it.
Identify all variables and data stores that receive information from external sources, and apply input validation to make sure that they are only initialized to expected values.
Explicitly initialize all variables and other data stores, either during declaration or just before the first usage.

consequences.note: NULL pointer dereferences usually result in the failure of the process unless exception handling (on some platforms) is available and implemented. Even when exception handling is being used, it can still be very difficult to return the software to a safe state of operation.
In rare circumstances, when NULL is equivalent to the 0x0 memory address and privileged code can access it, then writing or reading memory is possible, which may lead to code execution.
